goal: Implement a permanent Phase 4A quality and scope gate for coding memory: classify imported events and extracted candidates, quarantine low-value or synthetic observations without deleting raw facts, resolve raw project ids into auditable logical project scopes, and expose deterministic replay/reporting through the service, CLI, API, and tests.
success_criteria: Every new or replayed event receives a persisted quality evaluation with a classifier version, decision, score, and human-readable reasons; raw canonical events remain unchanged.

Every extracted candidate receives a persisted quality review; acknowledgement-only, future-tense, URL/glob/synthetic, or unsupported bindings cannot become accepted coding memories, while uncertain observations remain reviewable.

Consolidation is quality-aware and idempotent: quarantined candidates never create or mutate stable cards, accepted candidates retain evidence and existing card history, and unreviewed legacy rows are explicitly reported.

Raw project ids are preserved while exact roots and explicit aliases can resolve to a logical project scope with confidence and provenance; cross-scope references are reported rather than silently merged.
A replay/report command and REST endpoints can run the same gate over existing data in dry-run or write mode, with deterministic counts, input hashes, and quality-run audit records.
Focused quality, consolidation, API, replay, full regression, lint, compile, and UI syntax checks pass; no source or test scope drift is introduced.
constraints: SQLite remains the canonical local store; quality tables are additive projections and can be rebuilt by replay.
Preserve canonical event payloads, candidates, card versions, evidence, and relations; never use quality replay as a destructive reset.
Use deterministic local rules in the first implementation; provider/LLM-assisted classification may be added later behind the same versioned contract.
A code binding is accepted only with concrete repository evidence; URLs, globs, generated synthetic names, and skill/document paths are not code evidence.
Validation claims require an actual command or validation event; textual assertions alone are not proof.
Do not add an embedding service, graph database, cloud dependency, or native Codex Desktop hook in this slice.
non_goals: AST/LSP or live CodebaseMemory symbol verification; only evidence-shape and scope checks belong here.
Automatic destructive merging of all Project_J roots; alias suggestions must retain confidence and provenance.
Processing the remaining unextracted history until the quality gate itself is verified.
stop_condition: Stop after the additive migration, quality classifier/store/service integration, logical-scope resolver, replay/report API and CLI, focused and full regression checks, and an evidence-backed report of any legacy rows left for review.
